title: Define the exhaustive GMCP completion roadmap and implementation queue
goal: Make GMCP the complete local MCP server, client, host, gateway, tool, registry, conformance, security, operations, developer-experience, and interoperability environment. Inventory current implementation and authoritative standards; define traceable roadmap vectors with measurable mastery targets; create dependency-ordered implementation tasks covering every identified requirement; include explicit non-goals, evidence, acceptance, and a completeness audit so closing the queue is sufficient evidence of GMCP completion.
